turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of your class, before anyone called me. Explain that.
Thanks for coming in.
Thanks is noted. Now answer the question I asked: who entered that zero, and when?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk about it. Who entered the zero, and did anyone call me before they did?
How has his semester been at home?
That's not your question to ask me, Hale. We're here about the essay. Did you call me before you entered the zero?
He seems tired in class lately.
Don't do that. You're not going to bring Owen's home life into this to soften a zero. Did you call me before you entered it?
I know he works at the grocery store.
How you know where he works is a question for another day. Yes or no: did you call me before the zero went in?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
It was due Thursday and he handed it in, so yes, it was on time. That doesn't answer my question. Did you call me before the zero went in?
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." Concerns about what, specifically, and did you speak to Owen about them before you entered a zero?
The school's checker flagged it.
A checker flagged it. That's a machine's guess, not evidence. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
Then you know it's not enough to enter a zero on. What else do you have, Hale?
I also looked at the version history.
Version history. Show me what it says and the dates on it. I'm writing this down.
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late." What time, exactly, and on which date? Give me the timestamps, not an impression.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
Two big pieces isn't a timestamp. Show me the two pieces with the times on them. Did you speak to Owen about this before you entered a zero?
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
Afterward. So the zero went in first and the questions came after. That's the order I'm objecting to. Did you call me before the zero was entered, yes or no?
He had trouble explaining it.
Owen had trouble explaining his own essay to you, after you'd already given him a zero. That isn't evidence. Did you call me, yes or no?
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
Then withdraw the zero. Put it in writing and I'll hear the rest. I'm not waiting on that for the next hour.
What do you think should happen next?
You're asking me to do your job. The zero comes off, Hale. Then we talk about what happens to Owen's essay, in private, with nothing on his record.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not going to answer that. I'm here about Owen's mark. Take the zero off and I'll listen to what you propose.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
Okay. Before I hear a rewrite, I want two things: the zero withdrawn, and an assurance that nothing goes on Owen's record. Both in writing. What's your proposal?
It would be at lunch, in my room.
Private, not in front of his class, and supervised. That's the only part of this I'm prepared to discuss. Who would supervise it, and when?
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up" is not "nothing goes on file." Say that sentence again without the condition, and put it in an email to me today.
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email yourself. What I need is the zero withdrawn, a private supervised rewrite, and nothing on Owen's record, in writing.
Thanks for your time.
My call is in about twenty minutes, so I'll take one more thing from you before I leave. Put the zero withdrawal and the nothing-on-file terms in an email to me today.
